description: Generate similar ecommerce images from a reference image with optional prompt and strength controls.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of a JPG, PNG, or WEBP reference image up to 10 MB and at most 4096 pixels in both width and height.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Optional prompt for the desired variation, up to 600 characters.

fields.name: weight
fields.description: Reference image weight from 0 to 2. Defaults to 2.

fields.name: width
fields.description: Desired output width in pixels, from 384 to 4096.

fields.name: height
fields.description: Desired output height in pixels, from 384 to 4096.

fields.name: scale
fields.description: Optional aspect ratio. Provide scale or both width and height.

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 4.
